name: Tobin Sedge
source_profile: ● Tobin Sedge (CG) is a veteran river pilot and Ranger who has earned considerable respect among independent boatmen and dockworkers. He despises the Blackwake Company's piracy and has repeatedly clashed with his superiors over their willingness to overlook the misconduct of politically connected merchants.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 21 (source excerpt; may be partial)
